verification.title: Authenticity check
verification.intro: Every PDF from hocX is registered. Anyone who receives a file can check on the public verification page, without an account, whether it comes unchanged from hocX.
verification.showIdentity: Show name and logo on the verification page
verification.showIdentityHint: When off, the verification page only shows that the document comes unchanged from hocX, not from whom.
verification.showNewerVersionHint: Applies to minutes: if there is a newer version, the verification page shows its number but no content.
verification.verificationExplanation: With a verification, hocX confirms that this account belongs to your organisation. The verification page then shows the “Verified organisation” badge (only if name and logo are shown). If the name changes, the verification is revoked.
verification.revokedNameChanged: The verification was revoked on {date} because the name changed. You can request it again.
verification.revokedByAdmin: The verification was revoked by hocX on {date}.
verification.verifiedButHidden: The badge only appears once name and logo are shown on the verification page.
verification.pendingSince: Request from {date} for “{name}”. hocX will get in touch if evidence is missing.
verification.requestMessagePlaceholder: e.g. commercial register entry, website or articles of association
verification.saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
verification.previewHint: This is what the result looks like for a sample document.
verification.previewText: This file is an unchanged copy of a document created with hocX on {date}.
verification.previewCreatedBy: Created in the hocX account of {name}.
verification.previewNewer: There is a newer version (v1.3) of this document.
